🎥🎬: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth (2026)

Brad Pitt returns as Cliff Booth, the legendary stuntman from Once Upon a Time… in Hollywood, in a new adventure set in 1977 Los Angeles. Eight years after the events of the original film, Cliff has traded Hollywood stunt work for something far more dangerous: becoming a fixer for some of the industry’s biggest names.

When talent agent Karen Crosby brings him a complicated situation involving her client, Charlie Peters, a famous television star, Cliff finds himself caught in a dangerous web of murder, blackmail, extortion, and organized crime. As he navigates Hollywood’s darker side, his street smarts, fearless attitude, and unconventional methods may be the only things keeping him alive.

Starring Brad Pitt, Elizabeth Debicki, Scott Caan, Carla Gugino, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II, and Timothy Olyphant. Directed by David Fincher and written by Quentin Tarantino.

Available in theaters.
